fee_notes: Royalty Fee is 5.75% of Gross Sales, payable weekly. Advertising Fee is 2.75% of Gross Sales, payable weekly; may be increased up to a maximum of 4% with 60 days' written notice (or higher based on franchisee vote). Technology and Support Fee is $170/month but may increase up to $750 per year on a compounding basis. Non-Compliance Charge includes $100/day plus a 1% increase to the Royalty Fee. Management Fee is 10% of Gross Sales plus costs if franchisor assumes management due to default or closure; 3% of Gross Sales plus costs if due to death, disability, or prolonged absence.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty Fee | 5.75% of Gross Sales | Payable weekly | See Notes 2 and 3.
Advertising Fee | 2.75% of Gross Sales | Payable weekly | See Notes 3 and 4.
Technology and Support Fee | $170 per month, but it may increase up to $750 per year on a compounding basis. | Payable monthly | This fee provides for your right to use certain technology that we mandate and make available for use in the operation of your Restaurant from time to time.
Non-Compliance Charge | $100 per day and increase of 1% to your Royalty Fee | As incurred | See Note 5.
Management Fee | 10% of Gross Sales, plus costs and expenses | As incurred | See Note 6.
Management Fee Due to Death, Disability or Prolonged Absence | 3% of Gross Sales, plus costs and expenses | As incurred | Due if we elect to manage your Restaurant upon your death, disability or prolonged absence.
